edges:trunk2.edge_prompt: Restate the sentence as room|direction|room, keeping the rooms in the order the sentence names them: the first room lies in that direction of the second. 'The hallway is south of the bathroom.' becomes hallway|south|bathroom. Reply with that line only.
edges:trunk2.which_prompt: Answer with the name of one room from the sentence and nothing else.
